text:
Alice M.: Hey team, hitting a weird stack on Windows + Python where our AsyncClient hangs during TLS handshake and token refresh concurrently. repro on 3.11.5, sdk v0.9.2.

Ben T.: ugh, can you paste repro steps / minimal snippet?

Alice M.: Sure — run on Windows 10 w/ system cert store. snippet:```python
import asyncio
from redwood import AsyncClient

async def main():
    client = AsyncClient(api_key=...)
    await client.generate("hello")

asyncio.run(main())
```
It works sometimes but often raises ssl.SSLError or just hangs at handshake. When I add token refresh (long-lived background refresh) and concurrent requests it freezes.

Camille R.: Do you have the exact traceback? that helps triage. Also which CA bundle is being used (certifi vs env)?

Alice M.: Trace excerpt:```
ssl.SSLError: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate (_ssl.c:1007)
# then later nothing, process still alive but no progress
```
Environment: python 3.11.5 (venv), pip installed certifi, no REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE set, windows certstore is primary. I tried setting SSL_CERT_FILE to certifi.where() and it reduces failures but then token refresh requests fail with 401 intermittently and retry logic seems to stop.

Ben T.: Two separate bugs possible: cert bundle precedence on Windows + async TLS handshake race with auth refresh. Can you repro with VERBOSE logs? set REDWOOD_SDK_LOG=debug and paste.

Alice M.: Pasted logs (truncated):```
[debug] ssl: using certfile=C:\Users\alice\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Lib\site-packages\certifi\cacert.pem
[debug] auth: refreshing token start
[debug] socket: handshake start
# handshake never completes, no error returned, worker thread stuck
```

Dave L.: Workaround for now: force SDK to use certifi bundle and disable background refresh:```py
client = AsyncClient(api_key=..., ca_bundle=certifi.where(), refresh_tokens=False)
```
But long term we need fix: 1) ensure our TLS layer doesn't depend on Windows certstore ordering; 2) make token refresh serializable (no concurrent refresh attempts); 3) improve retry/backoff when handshake hangs.

Camille R.: Filing issue. @sdk-bot can you create a GH issue with repro notes, logs, and label windows, ssl, async, auth-retry?

sdk-bot: Created issue redwood/redwood-py#421 (Windows: AsyncClient TLS hang during concurrent token refresh & cert bundle precedence) — https://github.com/redwood/redwood-py/issues/421

Ben T.: I can take the cert precedence fix — likely we should prefer SSL_CERT_FILE > REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE > certifi > windows store, and surface a clear warning when multiple are present. I'll also add a guard to ensure only one refresh runs at a time.

Alice M.: Thanks — can you add a short patch to docs about the ca_bundle param and env var precedence? saved me in the short term.

Dave L.: Will do a quick PR for docs + patch to AsyncClient (mutex around refresh) and add a small integration test on Github Actions windows-latest matrix.

Alice M.: Great, thx all :thumbsup:
